calls.title: GrowthBook Experimentation Best Practices
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Jake Heier, AE, and Jeremy Dorn, co-founder/tech lead) demoed their experimentation platform to the EQT team (Sebastian, Eric, Simon) who are evaluating it to optimize UX on their Sanity/Next.js website before a summer campaign. Key pain points include building a new experimentation program from scratch, low traffic (~1.5M sessions/year), and the need to connect GA4 data to BigQuery for metrics. Next steps: GrowthBook will enable enterprise features and a Slack support channel; the customer will share
